preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 50,000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 150,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer ai on the vertices must be between 0 and n.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, as it is a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must contain valid vertex indices between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly q lines, one for each query.
Each output value must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output value must not exceed the maximum value of n.
